title: China accuses Dutch of prolonging chip war that threatens to halt car factories
summary: Beijing tells Netherlands to ‘stop interfering’ after seizure of chipmaker Nexperia as export bans disrupt supply chainBusiness live – latest updatesChina has told the Netherlands to “stop interfering” in the seized chipmaker Nexperia, accusing it of prolonging a dispute that has disrupted the global car industry.The Dutch government took control of the semiconductor-maker at the end of September amid US securityconcerns about the company’s Chinese parent, Wingtech Technology.Continue reading...
